The '''EAV ''Bothan Whale''''' was a [[trans-oceanic shuttle]] used as a transport by [[Edan Spaceways]]. It was [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[J. M. Harrin]] and sailed the seas of [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
